clues.text: King Asa of Judah took the stones and timbers Baasha had used at Ramah to build up Geba and this town.
Every year Samuel went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to this place, judging Israel in each.
Samuel gathered Israel here, where they poured out water before the LORD, fasted, and confessed their sin.
Samuel set up a stone between this place and Shen, naming it Ebenezer: thus far the LORD has helped us.
Samuel called the people to the LORD here and told them they had rejected God by asking for a king.
Gedaliah, the governor Babylon set over Judah, was struck down here by Ishmael after they shared a meal.
The prophet Jeremiah went to Gedaliah in this town and stayed with the people left in the land.
